faq_1.a: Thikana is a Bangla-first residential rental discovery platform dedicated to Khulna, Bangladesh. It connects KUET, KU, and KMC students, bachelor professionals, and families directly with verified property owners for transparent, broker-free home and mess rentals.

faq_2.q: How can I find rental homes in Khulna on Thikana?
faq_2.a: Use the interactive search bar to filter by Khulna neighborhoods like Sonadanga, Boyra, Teligati, or Gallamari. You can filter by property type, maximum monthly rent, and lifestyle amenities, or use campus quick-links to browse verified homes near your university.

faq_3.q: How can students find mess accommodation?
faq_3.a: Students can browse dedicated student messes and bachelor rooms in Teligati near KUET, Gallamari near Khulna University, and Daulatpur near BL College. Filter by meal systems, study-friendly environment, high-speed WiFi, and generator backup.

faq_4.q: How can landlords publish property listings?
faq_4.a: Property owners in Khulna can register for a landlord account, upload property photos, set monthly rent and security deposits, describe amenities, and receive direct visit requests and messages from verified tenants without brokerage fees.

faq_5.q: What should you check before renting a home?
faq_5.a: Before choosing a rental home in Khulna, verify these 8 essentials: 1. Monthly rent and due date, 2. Security deposit terms and written receipts, 3. Utility charges and electric sub-meters, 4. Deep tube-well water and pump timing, 5. Campus or work commute distance, 6. Main gate lock times and house rules, 7. Direct landlord contact, 8. Move-in availability date.

faq_6.q: Can I compare rental properties side-by-side?
faq_6.a: Yes. Thikana features a dedicated Three-Property Comparison tool. Logged-in tenants can select up to three properties to compare rent, deposit terms, bedroom count, washrooms, generator backup, and match scores in a single unified table.

faq_7.q: How do in-person property visits work?
faq_7.a: Tenants can select their preferred date and convenient time slot on any listing page to request an in-person visit. The landlord receives the request directly and confirms the schedule, enabling a safe inspection before renting.

faq_8.q: How does Thikana handle property verification?
faq_8.a: Thikana conducts an administrative platform verification process covering landlord identity, phone contact, property availability, and submitted ownership or utility documents. Listings completing platform review display a verified badge to assure tenants of genuine information.

home.fiveStepsTitle: 5 Simple Steps to Find Rental Housing in Khulna
home.fiveStepsSubtitle: How to discover and secure your next home on Thikana:
home.step1Desc: Navigate to Thikana's property search to browse all active rental listings in Khulna.
home.step2Desc: Choose from Sonadanga, Boyra, Teligati (KUET), Gallamari (KU), or Daulatpur.
home.step3Desc: Filter by property type (Flat, Bachelor Room, Mess, Sublet) and your monthly budget.
home.step4Desc: Pin up to 3 listings to evaluate rent, advance terms, and amenities in one table.
home.step5Desc: Message property owners directly or request an in-person walkthrough at your convenience.
home.checklistSubheading: Confirm these 8 essential factors directly with the landlord before signing or paying an advance deposit:
home.chk1Desc: Confirm the exact monthly rent and the agreed payment deadline each month.
home.chk2Desc: Understand advance deposit terms (typically 1-2 months in Khulna) and secure a written receipt.
home.chk3Desc: Check electric sub-meter rates and whether cooking gas is cylinder or pipeline.
home.chk4Desc: Verify deep tube-well water availability and daily pump operation hours.
home.chk5Desc: Confirm travel time, distance, and easy rickshaw or auto access to campus or workplace.
home.chk6Desc: Ask about night gate lock timing (e.g. 11 PM) and visitor or meal policies.
home.chk7Desc: Ensure you communicate directly with the authentic property owner without intermediaries.
home.chk8Desc: Confirm the exact move-in date and make sure cleaning and repairs are completed.
